structural_change: r6 RTL (sector-local storage + gated reads, kept copies) placed by the placer without INCLUSIVE regions (the region groups crashed DPL); reset landed 2 stages. HBM-SU3 10-17 qcore r5 (coordinator 0dc): ot_hbm_su_static_qcore_r5 replaces the 66-root qcore (64 per-bank clk_rf + ctl + red; codex hbm_qcore_s_pinrung_r2, 76k FF on 330.48^2). One RF copy (8,192 flops) instead of six per-reader replicas, and only the selected word per read class is registered (raw k+1, rd k+2) instead of a raw/read_data register per (bank, reader) + bank-select mux: ~11.5k flops, ONE root clk_ctl (reducer SRAMs on it; g1 gate: clk_red reached SRAM clock pins, CTS refused a separate root). Read: per-sector word at k+1 from a per-sector address copy, sector select at k+2 (g1: 8,192-load address nets). Pins first (raw command/writer capture at k, decode after the flop). Same edges: commit k+1, rf_bword/rf_dsec k+3, scalar E+11; write-conflict FAULT +1 edge; invalid-read output words are don't-care (documented). Reducer SRAMs stacked on the 43.2 lattice; die faces kept (W slice, E channel, N clocks). Re-home: H-DIE-R7b/R8b grants put sucore_<q> beside its pgslices. g3 (HBM-SU6 10-17, g2 gate: rf_bcmd[*] 8,193 loads = synthesis merged the per-sector read-address copies with the rf_bcmd output flop; placement reg->reg -178.7 ps into mem D): every replicated pin-rung copy is a kept instance (keep_hierarchy ot_hbm_su_qcore_r5_kq): read address per (sector, class, 16-bit half), class 5 per (word slot, half), writer wv/wa/wd/rrv/rra per sector (8 banks each). Same edges; slice_x stays raw (a pin flop would move the E+1 operand edge). r6 (HH-11 10-19, route r5-1a1108053 NEEDS_RTL TT -314.4 / FF +11.49 / DRC 0, 6,633 TT-violating D: g_sec.u_wd -> mem D 20 levels (per-sector writer copies clumped at the E face, each sector's banks spread over the tile), class-5 r5a -> raw5 ~470 ps of placement buffers (slot kk read bank kk of all 8 sectors), cmd_p -> fault 18 levels; and route.period_ps 1111.111 made repair target 1111 instead of the 833 sign-off -> removed): one keep_hierarchy module per sector (ot_hbm_su_qcore_r6_sec: 8 banks x 4 rows x 32 b, raw writer copies incl. its own 256-b COLL data copy, one-hot priority write decode, read-address copies per (class, half), k+1 read registers GATED by the sector match), each placed as an INCLUSIVE region (sector_regions.tcl: 2 sectors per free band row, S/middle/N bands beside the SRAM rows); k+2 = OR of the 8 gated sector words (classes 0-4 and the class-5 row); write-conflict fault registered per sector (+1 edge, status only). Same ports + PRETREE 1 (HH-6: slice_t[267:0] on the W face beside slice_x, pretree_j beside the reducer), same edges (commit k+1, reads k+3, E+11, tree operand E+69).
